scoring_notes: No model identities or materials outside the seven allowed input files were sought.
Source-supported errata and semantic allowances apply equally. No predeclared weights changed.
Scores are equal-case means; each case is worth 100. Critical unsupported inference caps apply once per affected case after component scoring.
Each material erroneous proposition is counted once even if repeated. The C04 partial condition is one omission; three current-lien assertions are three critical claims in three cases.
All supplied evidence quotes match the same-case packet after whitespace normalization and satisfy the one-to-three-quote instruction.
